```sql
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

    SELECT bundle_code, item_sku, CAST(qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM bundle_edges
    UNION ALL
    SELECT be.bundle_code, be.item_sku, CAST(be.qty AS DOUBLE) * CAST(be2.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM bundle_expand be
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the model
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE as total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'ER7-160BLK74-0559'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        (e.total_qty * c.qty)::DOUBLE as total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind AND c.parent_code = e.child_code
    WHERE e.child_kind IN ('component', 'model')  -- only continue if parent is an assembly or model
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Filter to only assembly components to check if we need to continue
assembly_check AS (
    SELECT component_code 
    FROM component 
    WHERE is_assembly = true
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.total_qty), 0) as total_units_needed
FROM bom_explosion e
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = e.child_code
WHERE e.child_code = 'TAB-258-OAK-01682'
  AND comp.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Start with the model and its direct component children
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'TE1-180WAL41-0235'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand assembly components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        (be.total_qty * c.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = be.component_code
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = be.component_code
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = true
      AND c.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT be.component_code) AS distinct_parts
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = be.component_code
WHERE comp.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the model
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'AE1-160OAK40-0719'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind 
        AND c.parent_code = e.child_code
    WHERE e.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      AND GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (CASE 
              WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
              WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
              ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL 
           OR CASE 
              WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
              WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
              ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_components AS (
    -- Start with direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'CO7-140OAK43-0625'

      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode assembly components
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        mc.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = mc.component_code
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = mc.component_code

)

FROM model_components mc
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = mc.component_code
WHERE comp.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'AL8-140OAK56-0056'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        e.total_qty * c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = 'component' 
        AND c.parent_code = e.component_code
```

```sql
    -- Start with the model and find its direct components
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE as qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model' 
      AND c.parent_code = 'VI6-140GRY36-0521'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively find child components of assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        (mc.qty * c.qty)::DOUBLE as qty,
        GREATEST(mc.valid_from, c.valid_from) as valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN mc.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN mc.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(mc.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END as valid_to
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = mc.child_kind AND c.parent_code = mc.child_code
    WHERE c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

      AND (CASE 
            WHEN mc.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN mc.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(mc.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR

            WHEN mc.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN mc.valid_to
```

```sql
    UNION ALL

        mc.qty * c.qty AS qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = mc.component_code

)
```

```sql
        ss.sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle
    FROM listing l
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON l.sku_id = ss.sku_id

-- For non-bundle SKUs: direct model mapping
non_bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        uco.listing_id,
        uco.order_qty,
        ue.item_code AS model_code,
        ue.qty AS model_qty_per_sku,
        uco.order_qty * ue.qty AS model_units
    FROM uk_completed_orders uco
    JOIN listing_sku ls ON uco.listing_id = ls.listing_id
    JOIN u_explosion ue 
        ON ue.root_kind = 'sku' 
        AND ue.root_code = ls.sku_code
        AND ue.item_kind = 'model'
        AND ue.valid_from <= uco.order_date
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR uco.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
    WHERE ls.is_bundle = false
),
-- For bundle SKUs: explode to item SKUs, then to models
bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        uco.listing_id,
        uco.order_qty,
        ue2.item_code AS model_code,

),
```

```sql
WITH uk_completed_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'UK'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023
),
listing_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        l.listing_id,
        l.sku_id,
        ss.sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle
    FROM listing l
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON l.sku_id = ss.sku_id
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs: direct model mapping
non_bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.listing_id,
        ls.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM listing_sku ls
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
       AND uc.parent_code = ls.sku_code
       AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE ls.is_bundle = false
),
-- For bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.listing_id,
        ls.sku_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS item_qty_per_bundle
    FROM listing_sku ls
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
       AND uc.parent_code = ls.sku_code
       AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE ls.is_bundle = true
),
bundle_models AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.listing_id,
        bi.bundle_sku_code,
        bi.item_sku_code,
        bi.item_qty_per_bundle,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty_per_item
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
       AND uc.parent_code = bi.item_sku_code
       AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
),
-- Combine all listing-to-model mappings with quantities
listing_model_map AS (
    SELECT listing_id, model_code, model_qty_per_sku AS qty_per_unit
    FROM non_bundle_models
    UNION ALL
    SELECT listing_id, model_code, item_qty_per_bundle * model_qty_per_item AS qty_per_unit
    FROM bundle_models
),
-- Calculate total model units sold
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        lmm.model_code,
        SUM(uo.order_qty * lmm.qty_per_unit) AS total_units
    FROM uk_completed_orders uo
    JOIN listing_model_map lmm ON uo.listing_id = lmm.listing_id
    GROUP BY lmm.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_components AS (
    -- Start with the model VI6-180WAL12-0303
    SELECT 
        'model' as root_kind,
        'VI6-180WAL12-0303' as root_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE as qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'VI6-180WAL12-0303'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        mc.root_kind,
        mc.root_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        mc.qty * c.qty::DOUBLE as qty,
        GREATEST(mc.valid_from, c.valid_from) as valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN mc.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN mc.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(mc.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END as valid_to
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = mc.child_kind AND c.parent_code = mc.child_code
    WHERE mc.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      -- Only continue if parent is an assembly
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component comp 
          WHERE comp.component_code = mc.child_code AND comp.is_assembly = true
      )
),
all_parts AS (
    -- Get all leaf components (parts, not assemblies) with their total quantities
    SELECT 
        mc.child_code as component_code,
        SUM(mc.qty) as total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    WHERE mc.child_kind = 'component'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component comp 
          WHERE comp.component_code = mc.child_code AND comp.is_assembly = true
      )
    GROUP BY mc.child_code
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(p.total_qty * c.unit_cost), 2) as total_parts_cost
FROM all_parts p
JOIN component c ON c.component_code = p.component_code;
```

```sql
    SELECT model_id, model_code
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'VI7-180OAK29-0708'
),
-- Recursively explode the BOM starting from the model
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        uc.qty as qty_per_unit

      AND uc.child_kind = 'component'

      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        c.category,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty as qty_per_unit

    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = be.component_code

      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
-- Sum up costs for all parts (non-assembly components)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty_per_unit * unit_cost), 2) as total_parts_cost
FROM bom_explosion
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_components AS (
    -- Start from company models and traverse down through compositions
    SELECT 
        'model' as parent_kind,
        cm.model_code as parent_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty as direct_qty,
        c.qty as total_qty
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_code = cm.model_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

    -- Recursive step: traverse down through assembly components
    SELECT 
        mc.child_kind as parent_kind,
        mc.child_code as parent_code,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty as direct_qty,
        mc.total_qty * c.qty as total_qty

    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = mc.child_code
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_code = mc.child_code
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = true
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct compositions from models to components
    SELECT 
        'model' AS root_kind,
        parent_code AS root_code,
        child_kind AS item_kind,
        child_code AS item_code,
        qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'model'
      AND child_kind = 'component'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: direct compositions from models to assemblies (need to recurse)
    SELECT 
        'model' AS root_kind,
        parent_code AS root_code,
        child_kind AS item_kind,
        child_code AS item_code,
        qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'model'
      AND child_kind = 'component'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM component c 
          WHERE c.component_code = u_composition.child_code 
          AND c.is_assembly = true
      )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode assemblies into their sub-components
    SELECT 
        be.root_kind,
        be.root_code,
        uc.child_kind AS item_kind,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        be.qty * uc.qty AS qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
```

```sql
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = be.item_code AND c.is_assembly = true
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Start from non-bundle SKUs that map to models
    SELECT 
        'sku' AS root_kind,
        s.sku_code AS root_code,
        'model' AS item_kind,
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE AS qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Follow model -> component and component -> component edges
    SELECT 
        be.root_kind,
        be.root_code,
        c.child_kind AS item_kind,
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        be.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(be.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = be.item_kind AND c.parent_code = be.item_code
    WHERE c.child_kind IN ('model', 'component')
        AND GREATEST(be.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2026-10-01'

                WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
                WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
                ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, c.valid_to)
            END IS NULL OR 
            CASE 
                WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
                WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
                ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, c.valid_to)
            END >= DATE '2026-10-01')
```

```sql
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2025-12-31' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')
),
-- Find bundle SKUs that contain SKUs mapping to our model
bundle_contents AS (
    -- Direct items in bundles
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        b.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,
        uc.qty as item_qty,
        uc.child_code as item_sku_code
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2025-12-31' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')
),
-- Find which bundle items map to our model
bundle_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        bc.bundle_sku_code,
        bc.bundle_sku_id,
        bc.item_qty * COALESCE(uc2.qty, 1) as total_model_qty,
        bc.item_sku_code
    FROM bundle_contents bc
    LEFT JOIN u_composition uc2 ON uc2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc2.parent_code = bc.item_sku_code
        AND uc2.child_kind = 'model' AND uc2.child_code = 'VI1-140WHT65-0259'
        AND uc2.valid_from <= '2025-12-31' AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR uc2.valid_to >= '2025-01-01')
    WHERE uc2.qty IS NOT NULL
),
-- All SKUs that contribute to model sales, with their model quantity per SKU unit
all_contributing_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, model_qty as qty_per_sku_unit FROM direct_skus
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bundle_sku_id, total_model_qty as qty_per_sku_unit FROM bundle_to_model
),
-- Get all listings for these SKUs
relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, l.sku_id, acs.qty_per_sku_unit
    FROM listing l
    JOIN all_contributing_skus acs ON l.sku_id = acs.sku_id
),
-- Calculate total model units sold
model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(ol.qty * rl.qty_per_sku_unit) as total_model_units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN relevant_listings rl ON ol.listing_id = rl.listing_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' 
        AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COALESCE(total_model_units, 0)::INT as units_sold FROM model_sales
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, find all SKUs that map directly or indirectly to model VI1-160BLK76-0270
-- Direct mapping: non-bundle SKU -> model
-- Indirect: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model

-- Step 1: Get all SKUs that directly map to the target model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        s.is_bundle,
        c.qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'model' AND c.child_code = 'VI1-160BLK76-0270'
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),

-- Step 2: Get all bundle SKUs that contain SKUs mapping to the target model (directly or through other bundles)
-- We need to trace through bundle compositions recursively
bundle_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct mappings from bundle to item SKU that maps to target model
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,
        b.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        c.child_code as item_sku_code,
        c.qty as item_qty_in_bundle
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
        AND c.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM u_composition mc 
            WHERE mc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND mc.parent_code = c.child_code
            AND mc.child_kind = 'model' AND mc.child_code = 'VI1-160BLK76-0270'
            AND mc.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (mc.valid_to IS NULL OR mc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
        )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: bundles containing other bundles that eventually map to target model
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,
        b.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        bc.item_sku_code,
        c.qty * bc.item_qty_in_bundle as item_qty_in_bundle
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN bundle_contents bc ON bc.bundle_sku_code = c.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
        AND c.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),

-- Step 3: Combine all SKUs that contribute to model sales with their model quantity per SKU unit
all_contributing_skus AS (
    -- Direct SKUs (non-bundle)
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        model_qty_per_sku as model_qty_per_sku_unit
    FROM direct_skus
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: need to trace through to get total model qty
    SELECT 
        bc.bundle_sku_id as sku_id,
        bc.bundle_sku_code as sku_code,
        mc.qty * bc.item_qty_in_bundle as model_qty_per_sku_unit
    FROM bundle_contents bc
    JOIN u_composition mc ON mc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND mc.parent_code = bc.item_sku_code
        AND mc.child_kind = 'model' AND mc.child_code = 'VI1-160BLK76-0270'
    WHERE mc.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (mc.valid_to IS NULL OR mc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),

-- Step 4: Aggregate model quantity per SKU unit (in case multiple paths)
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        sku_id,
        sku_code,
        SUM(model_qty_per_sku_unit) as total_model_qty_per_sku_unit
    FROM all_contributing_skus
    GROUP BY sku_id, sku_code
)

-- Step 5: Calculate total model units sold in 2024
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * smq.total_model_qty_per_sku_unit), 0) as total_model_units_sold
FROM orders o
JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sku_model_qty smq ON smq.sku_id = l.sku_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
```

```sql
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
      AND o.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14')
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs, get model mapping via u_composition (sku -> model)
-- For bundle SKUs, get contained SKUs via u_composition (sku -> sku)
sku_exploded AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.sku_code,
        ol.is_bundle,
        CASE 
            WHEN ol.is_bundle THEN uc.child_code  -- the contained SKU
            ELSE uc.child_code  -- the model for non-bundle
        END AS child_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN ol.is_bundle THEN 'sku'
            ELSE 'model'
        END AS child_kind,
        uc.qty AS comp_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = ol.sku_code
        AND uc.valid_from <= ol.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),
-- For bundle SKUs, we need to explode further to get models
-- For non-bundle SKUs, we already have models
with_models AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: already have models
    SELECT 
        se.order_qty,
        se.order_date,
        se.sku_code,
        se.child_code AS model_code,
        se.comp_qty AS sku_to_model_qty
    FROM sku_exploded se
    WHERE se.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: need to go sku -> sku (item) -> model
    SELECT 
        se.order_qty,
        se.order_date,
        se.sku_code,
        uc2.child_code AS model_code,
        se.comp_qty * uc2.qty AS sku_to_model_qty
    FROM sku_exploded se
    JOIN u_composition uc2
        ON uc2.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc2.parent_code = se.child_code
        AND uc2.valid_from <= se.order_date
        AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR se.order_date <= uc2.valid_to)
    WHERE se.is_bundle = true
),
-- Now explode model -> components using u_explosion
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        wm.order_qty,
        wm.order_date,
        wm.sku_code,
        wm.model_code,
        wm.sku_to_model_qty,
        ue.item_code AS component_code,
        ue.qty AS model_component_qty
    FROM with_models wm
    JOIN u_explosion ue
        ON ue.root_kind = 'model'
        AND ue.root_code = wm.model_code
        AND ue.item_kind = 'component'
        AND ue.valid_from <= wm.order_date
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR wm.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
),
-- Filter to the specific part and calculate total consumption
part_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.order_qty * mc.sku_to_model_qty * mc.model_component_qty AS total_part_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component c ON mc.component_code = c.component_code
    WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-998-OAK-02932'
      AND c.is_assembly = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_part_qty), 0) AS total_consumed
FROM part_consumption
```

```sql
-- For non-bundle SKUs, get the model mapping via u_composition on order date
-- For bundle SKUs, we need to explode to child SKUs first
-- First, get all SKU-level compositions valid on order date (for bundles)
sku_compositions AS (
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.order_line_qty,

        uc.qty AS composition_qty

        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.valid_from <= osl.order_date 
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR osl.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE osl.is_bundle = true
),

-- Combine: bundle SKUs expanded to child SKUs, non-bundle SKUs as-is
expanded_skus AS (
    -- Bundle SKUs expanded to their child SKUs
    SELECT 
        sc.order_id,
        sc.order_date,
        sc.order_line_qty * sc.composition_qty AS total_sku_qty,
        sc.sku_code
    FROM sku_compositions sc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Non-bundle SKUs pass through directly
    SELECT 
        osl.order_id,
        osl.order_date,
        osl.order_line_qty AS total_sku_qty,
        osl.sku_code
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    WHERE osl.is_bundle = false
),

sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.order_date,
        es.total_sku_qty,
        es.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN u_composition uc
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.parent_code = es.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= es.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR es.order_date <= uc.valid_to)

        stm.total_sku_qty,
        stm.sku_code,
        stm.model_code,

        AND ue.item_kind = 'component'
        AND ue.valid_from <= stm.order_date
```

```sql
bundle_children AS (
    SELECT ls.order_id, ls.listing_id, ls.order_qty, ls.sku_code AS parent_sku_code,

    FROM listing_skus ls
```

```sql
WITH completed_ca_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),
order_sku_qty AS (
    -- Total quantity of each SKU sold in completed CA orders in 2023
    SELECT 
        l.sku_id,
        SUM(ol.qty) AS total_sku_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN completed_ca_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
    GROUP BY l.sku_id
),
sku_model_units AS (
    -- For non-bundle SKUs: map directly to models via u_explosion
    -- For bundle SKUs: explode to item SKUs, then map those to models
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ss.sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle,
        -- For non-bundle SKU, get models directly
        -- For bundle SKU, get models from contained SKUs
        COALESCE(
            -- Non-bundle: direct model mapping
            (SELECT ue.item_code
             FROM u_explosion ue
             WHERE ue.root_kind = 'sku' 
               AND ue.root_code = ss.sku_code
               AND ue.item_kind = 'model'
               AND ue.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
               AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR ue.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')),
            -- Bundle: need to go through contained SKUs
            NULL
        ) AS direct_model_code
    FROM sales_sku ss
),
bundle_model_exploded AS (
    -- For bundle SKUs, explode to find all contained SKUs and their models
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id AS bundle_sku_id,
        b.sku_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        ue_child.item_code AS child_sku_code,
        ue_child.qty AS child_qty_in_bundle
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_explosion ue_child ON ue_child.root_kind = 'sku' 
        AND ue_child.root_code = b.sku_code
        AND ue_child.item_kind = 'sku'
        AND ue_child.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (ue_child.valid_to IS NULL OR ue_child.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),
bundle_to_model AS (
    -- Map bundle child SKUs to their models
    SELECT 
        be.bundle_sku_id,
        be.bundle_sku_code,
        ue_model.item_code AS model_code,
        be.child_qty_in_bundle
    FROM bundle_model_exploded be
    JOIN u_explosion ue_model ON ue_model.root_kind = 'sku'
        AND ue_model.root_code = be.child_sku_code
        AND ue_model.item_kind = 'model'
        AND ue_model.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (ue_model.valid_to IS NULL OR ue_model.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
non_bundle_models AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs with their models
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ue.item_code AS model_code,
        1.0 AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku ss
    JOIN u_explosion ue ON ue.root_kind = 'sku'
        AND ue.root_code = ss.sku_code
        AND ue.item_kind = 'model'
        AND ue.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR ue.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
),
all_sku_model_mappings AS (
    -- Combine non-bundle and bundle mappings
    SELECT sku_id, model_code, model_qty_per_sku FROM non_bundle_models
    UNION ALL
    -- For bundles, we need to aggregate child model quantities
    SELECT 
        bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        model_code,
        SUM(child_qty_in_bundle) AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM bundle_to_model
    GROUP BY bundle_sku_id, model_code
),
model_units_sold AS (
    -- Calculate total units per model
    SELECT 
        asm.model_code,
        SUM(osq.total_sku_qty * asm.model_qty_per_sku) AS total_model_units
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN all_sku_model_mappings asm ON osq.sku_id = asm.sku_id
    GROUP BY asm.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_units_sold
ORDER BY total_model_units DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
    JOIN u_composition uc2 ON uc2.parent_kind = 'sku'

        AND uc2.valid_from <= '2023-12-31'
        AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR uc2.valid_to >= '2023-01-01')
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE model_components AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the model
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'NO3-160BLK32-0226'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2023-11-06'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2023-11-06')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        mc.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(mc.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN mc.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN mc.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(mc.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = mc.child_kind AND c.parent_code = mc.child_code
    WHERE mc.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2023-11-06'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2023-11-06')
      AND GREATEST(mc.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2023-11-06'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN mc.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN mc.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(mc.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR 
           CASE 
               WHEN mc.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN mc.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(mc.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END >= DATE '2023-11-06')
),
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all components (assemblies and parts) in the model on 2023-05-22 with their quantities
model_parts AS (
    -- Direct components from model
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'AL2-120BLK08-0008'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2023-05-22'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2023-05-22')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies into their children
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        mp.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        mp.level + 1
    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = 'component' 
        AND c.parent_code = mp.component_code
        AND c.child_kind = 'component'
        AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2023-05-22'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2023-05-22')
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM component comp 
        WHERE comp.component_code = mp.component_code 
        AND comp.is_assembly = true
    )
),
-- Get leaf parts (non-assembly components) with their total quantities
leaf_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.component_code,
        mp.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = mp.component_code
    WHERE comp.is_assembly = false
    
    UNION
    
    -- Also include direct parts that are not in any assembly path (no children)
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = c.child_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'AL2-120BLK08-0008'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2023-05-22'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2023-05-22')
      AND comp.is_assembly = false
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM u_composition c2 
          WHERE c2.parent_kind = 'component' 
          AND c2.parent_code = c.child_code
          AND c2.valid_from <= DATE '2023-05-22'
          AND (c2.valid_to IS NULL OR c2.valid_to >= DATE '2023-05-22')
      )
),
-- Sum quantities for parts that appear via multiple paths
part_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        component_code,
        SUM(total_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM leaf_parts
    GROUP BY component_code
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(pq.total_qty * comp.unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM part_quantities pq
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = pq.component_code;
```
